caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a sculpted figure of an eagle positioned on a rounded base. The eagle has its wings raised and outstretched, with detailed feathers visible on both the wings and body. The bird's head is turned slightly to its right, with its beak open, and its talons are gripping the base. The colors used are primarily shades of brown, gold, and green, with darker tones accentuating the feather outlines and muscle structure. The background is a uniform light beige, and there are no other objects or additional features present. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the text "BØRS HOLMENSJOKTH" is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Metal Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
